title: Designing a QTL mapping population
text: Population types take different arguments: RILs tune filial generation, BCsFt tunes backcrosses generation, NAM tunes number families, MAGIC number founders. sim_set() holds one spec per type, grid, runs seeds, like workflow set. Every design 300 lines one location, use plots.  detecting one biallelic QTL 300 lines, biparental population hard beat: RIL BC1Ft lead. Later filial generations barely change power shrink location error, meioses break linkage. F2 (phenotyped F2:3 family means) quickest, 2 years results, less power: additive variance QTL F2 half RILs. Two backcrosses lower power, since fewer lines carry donor allele. NAM AB-NAM lose power families added, 300 lines spread many families leave lines per family QTL allele segregates families whose donor carries . MAGIC gives narrowest location error multiparent designs costs , since every line needs four- eight-way cross. criterion counts detection one biallelic QTL. NAM MAGIC usually chosen leaves : many alleles, wider genetic base chance map several donors’ alleles . metric , added sim_metric(), rank differently; study code change.
